notes:
Debug release: name it Log Off, and move the tag with the build

The release around the APK was wrong in three ways while the file itself
was fine. The debug tag still pointed at 75e86ee from 1 Sep, so the page
offered source code unrelated to the attached build. The title and body
still said "Relève", a name the app dropped. And nothing on the page
mentioned that the debug signing key is regenerated every run, which is
the one thing that makes an install fail.

Move the tag to the built commit, title it from versionName, state both
version lines and the commit, and lead with the uninstall step. Drop the
prerelease flag too: this is the only way to install the app, so it
should show on the repository home page.
